title: relgap pins --format json
description: The report-v1.json envelope with pins data: the scanned repositories and every pin found, sorted by repo, file and line.

repos.description: Scanned repository directories, slash-separated, as reached from the roots.

tool.description: Name relgap digest accepts: a registry name, github:owner/repo, aqua:package, or kind:name for tfprovider, chart, image and action pins. Empty when the pin maps to no known tool.

raw_name.description: The name as written, e.g. TERRAFORM_VERSION, hashicorp/aws or http:kafka.

version.description: The value without a leading v (or go for a go.mod toolchain), for comparison.

exact.description: True when the value allows exactly one version.

match.description: exact (1.15.8), constraint (~> 1.15), prefix (26) or channel (latest, lts, corretto-17).

line.description: 1-based; 0 when the source has no lines (a Renovate report).
